fewShots.question: Wer erklaert Direct Lake?
fewShots.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:SPEAKS_IN]->(d:Document)-[:EXPLAINS]->(c:Concept {id: 'tool:direct-lake'})
RETURN p.name AS person, count(d) AS folgen GROUP BY person ORDER BY folgen DESC

fewShots.question: Was wurde zu Translytical Task Flows gesagt?
fewShots.query:
MATCH (k:Claim)-[:ABOUT]->(c:Concept {id: 'tool:translytical-task-flows'})
RETURN k.kind AS art, k.aussage AS aussage, k.doc_id AS folge, k.start_s AS sekunde
ORDER BY sekunde LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: Was verbindet Direct Lake und DirectQuery?
fewShots.query:
MATCH (a:Concept {id: 'tool:direct-lake'})<-[m1:MENTIONS]-(d:Document)-[m2:MENTIONS]->(b:Concept {id: 'tool:directquery'})
RETURN d.title AS folge, m1.segments AS stellen_a, m2.segments AS stellen_b
ORDER BY stellen_a DESC LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: Was sagt Artur Koenig zu Direct Lake?
fewShots.query:
MATCH (p:Person {id: 'person:artur-konig'})-[:SPEAKS_IN]->(d:Document)-[:STATES]->(k:Claim)-[:ABOUT]->(c:Concept {id: 'tool:direct-lake'})
RETURN d.title AS folge, d.published AS datum, k.aussage AS aussage, k.start_s AS sekunde
ORDER BY datum DESC LIMIT 10

fewShots.question: Welche Kernaussagen zu Microsoft Fabric sitzen genau auf der Sekunde?
fewShots.query:
MATCH (k:Claim)-[:ABOUT]->(c:Concept {id: 'tool:microsoft-fabric'})
WHERE k.`precision` = 'word'
RETURN k.aussage AS aussage, k.start_s AS sekunde, k.anchor AS transkriptstelle LIMIT 20

fewShots.question: Welche Themen haengen mit dem Sternschema zusammen?
fewShots.query:
MATCH (a:Concept {id: 'topic:sternschema'})-[r:RELATES_TO]-(b:Concept)
RETURN b.name AS thema, r.weight AS gemeinsame_segmente ORDER BY gemeinsame_segmente DESC LIMIT 15

fewShots.question: Welche Themen behandelt der Themenbereich Microsoft Fabric?
fewShots.query:
MATCH (b:Bucket)<-[:IN_BUCKET]-(d:Document)-[m:MENTIONS]->(c:Concept)
WHERE b.name CONTAINS 'Fabric'
RETURN c.name AS thema, count(d) AS folgen GROUP BY thema ORDER BY folgen DESC LIMIT 15
